name: EPAY HCM
description_en:
EPAY HCM combines HR records, onboarding, benefits, time and attendance, and payroll services, with particular emphasis on distributed hourly workforces. Its HR module uses a master employee record and employee self-service, while time collection and payroll processing are distinct capabilities to scope in the purchase.

The documented US forms, tax identifiers and reporting examples make jurisdiction an important selection condition. Global time tracking does not establish equivalent payroll tax service in every country. This review reads current public pages, some of which still carry older promotional material, without verifying an active customer configuration.
description_zh:
EPAY HCM 组合 HR 档案、入职、福利、工时考勤及工资服务，重点面向分散作业的小时工团队。HR 模块使用统一员工主档和自助服务，工时采集与工资处理则是采购时需明确的不同能力。

官方列出的美国表单、税务编号及报告示例，使适用辖区成为重要条件。全球工时追踪不代表每个国家均提供相同工资税服务。本研究读取当前可访问公开页面，其中部分仍带有较旧宣传内容，未验证活跃客户配置。

core_features.explanation_en: Employees submit personal and payroll details; HR and managers approve changes, with documents and organizational information on the master record.
core_features.explanation_zh: 员工提交个人及工资资料，由 HR 和经理审核修改；主档保存文档和组织信息。

core_features.explanation_en: Biometric clocks, GPS mobile, telephone IVR and web collection can support different sites and work patterns.
core_features.explanation_zh: 生物识别打卡器、GPS 移动端、电话 IVR 和网页采集可用于不同地点及工作模式。

core_features.explanation_en: The payroll offering describes gross-to-net adjustments, multiple FEINs, tax filing and garnishment processing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 工资产品说明税前到实发调整、多 FEIN、税务申报及扣押款处理。

pricing.summary_en: Sales quote required; modules, devices, payroll services, implementation and contract terms remain unpriced.
pricing.summary_zh: 需要销售报价，模块、设备、工资服务、实施及合同条件尚无核实金额。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Establish the record before the first pay run
sections.title_zh: 首轮工资前建立员工档案
sections.en: HR describes collecting demographic and direct-deposit details, tax forms and client-specific documents, plus digital signatures and onboarding tasks. Benefit plans are presented according to pay group and residence. For an illustrative new hourly worker, verify the correct work site, pay group, tax forms and benefit eligibility before accepting the record into payroll. The vendor says the record flows across HCM components; actual validation, approvals and exceptions need a tenant demonstration. Document processing and compliance reports support administrative work but do not independently prove legal correctness.
sections.zh: HR 页面说明可收集人口资料、直接存款信息、税表及客户专属文档，并提供数字签名和入职任务，按工资组及居住地展示福利方案。以新入职小时工为例，进入工资系统前应核对工作地点、工资组、税表和福利资格。供应商称主档贯穿 HCM 组件，但实际校验、审批和异常需在租户中演示。文档处理和合规报告有助于行政管理，不能独立证明法律正确性。

sections.title_en: Test the difficult shift, not only a normal day
sections.title_zh: 测试复杂班次而非仅正常工作日
sections.en: EPAY’s attendance page focuses on overtime, union contracts, multiple pay groups, job locations and shift differentials. Collection options include biometric devices, GPS mobile, telephone IVR and browser entry. A meaningful pilot would cover a worker moving between sites or pay rates during one shift, plus a missed punch and a meal-break alert. Verify recorded events, rule application and payroll output separately. Marketing claims that the product accommodates every rule or eliminates errors are not adopted as guarantees; hardware, connectivity, biometric handling and correction approval were not tested.
sections.zh: EPAY 考勤页重点描述加班、工会合同、多工资组、工作地点及班次差额。采集方式包含生物识别设备、GPS 移动端、电话 IVR 及浏览器录入。试运行应覆盖同一班次切换地点或工资费率、漏卡及用餐休息提醒，并分别核对原始事件、规则应用和工资输出。产品可适应所有规则或消除错误的营销说法不作为保证；硬件、连接、生物信息处理和纠错审批均未测试。

sections.title_en: Separate payroll services from HR reporting
sections.title_zh: 区分工资服务与 HR 报表
sections.en: The HR module provides standard and ad-hoc reports across payroll, leave, benefits and schedules. The separate payroll page goes further: recurring earnings and deductions, multiple FEINs, real-time gross-to-net adjustments, voids, off-cycle checks, filing and garnishment services. It also describes general-ledger exports and group-level access restrictions. These are vendor-described service capabilities, not evidence that every HR subscription contains them. Scope the employer entities, state and local obligations, funding deadlines and responsibility for corrections in the contract. A free pay card is not a free HCM subscription.
sections.zh: HR 模块提供工资、休假、福利和排班的标准及自定义报表。独立工资页进一步描述固定收入扣款、多 FEIN、实时税前到实发调整、作废、非周期支票、申报及扣押款服务，也说明总账导出和按组限制访问。这些是供应商描述的服务能力，不代表每份 HR 订阅均包含。应在合同写明雇主实体、州及地方义务、资金截止时间和纠错责任。免费工资卡不等于免费 HCM 订阅。

sections.title_en: Obtain a module and service quote
sections.en: The official contact page routes buyers to sales and separates timekeeping support from other inquiries. No numeric HCM rate, minimum headcount, contract duration or implementation charge was established in these sources. Ask for HR, attendance, devices, payroll, tax services, migration, training and support as separate quote items. A demo or complimentary workforce discussion does not establish a free operational plan. The pages describe a cloud service, but the infrastructure wording for time and attendance should not automatically be extended to all HCM components or jurisdictions.
sections.zh: 官方联系页引导向销售询价，并区分工时支持和其他咨询。所读来源未确立 HCM 的数值费率、最低人数、合同期限或实施费。报价应分别列出 HR、考勤、设备、工资、税务服务、迁移、培训及支持。演示或免费人员运营讨论不代表可免费投入运营。页面描述云服务，但针对工时考勤的基础设施表述不能自动扩展至所有 HCM 组件或辖区。

sections.title_en: Prepare a parallel payroll acceptance case
sections.title_zh: 准备并行工资验收场景
sections.en: EPAY is relevant to employers coordinating hourly staff across sites and complex pay rules. A team looking for a simple salaried-employee directory should weigh the broader operational scope. Prepare employee identifiers, site and job codes, pay rules, benefit groups and opening balances; compare a parallel payroll with the existing authoritative result, including a correction or void. Public pages retain items such as a 2023 calendar promotion, so feature availability and service terms need written confirmation. Export completeness, retention, hosting jurisdiction, implementation behavior and source-code licensing remain unverified.
sections.zh: EPAY 适合评估跨地点协调小时工并管理复杂工资规则的需求。仅需简单固定薪资员工通讯录的团队，应衡量更广运营范围。需准备员工编号、地点及岗位编码、工资规则、福利组和期初余额，并用并行工资与既有权威结果比较，包含更正或作废。公开页面仍保留 2023 年日历宣传等内容，功能可用性和服务条款需书面确认。完整导出、保留期限、托管辖区、实施行为及源代码许可尚未核实。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.zh: 未执行打卡、员工更新、工资、税务申报或总账集成。

research_gaps.en: Current availability, exact service contract, retention, hosting and complete exports remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 当前可用性、具体服务合同、保留期限、托管及完整导出仍未核实。
